title: Chapter 1 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of AI language models, basic prompts, and the prompt engineering mindset.

questions.question: What is the primary function of a Large Language Model (LLM)?
options: Generate text by predicting the next token
questions.explanation: LLMs generate text based on patterns learned during training; they are probabilistic next‑token predictors.

questions.question: Why is vague prompting problematic?
options: The model’s probability distribution becomes too broad, leading to unpredictable outputs
questions.explanation: Vague prompts give the model too many plausible paths, resulting in outputs that may miss your intent.

questions.question: True or False: An LLM understands language exactly like a human does.
questions.explanation: LLMs don’t truly ‘understand’; they generate statistically plausible text based on training data.

questions.question: What does a prompt do?
options: It trains the model on new data
It acts as the input that steers the model’s output
questions.explanation: The prompt is the text you feed to the model; it heavily influences the generated response.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes prompt engineering?
options: Designing and refining prompts to get desired outputs from AI
questions.explanation: Prompt engineering is the practice of crafting effective inputs to control AI outputs.

questions.question: An LLM predicts the most likely _____ based on the previous text.
questions.explanation: LLMs generate output token by token, each chosen from a probability distribution.

questions.question: In the genie analogy, why must you be precise with your ‘wish’?
options: Because the genie interprets your words literally
Because the genie only understands pictures
Because the genie can only grant one wish
questions.explanation: The literal interpretation means any ambiguity can lead to an unintended result.

questions.question: What does the ‘context window’ refer to?
options: The time limit for generating a response
The maximum number of tokens the model can process at once
The screen size of the chat app
The number of users chatting simultaneously
questions.explanation: Context window is the token limit that includes both the prompt and the generated answer.

questions.question: True or False: Adding a persona like ‘You are a helpful tutor’ can change the tone of the model’s response.
questions.explanation: Persona instructions shift the model’s style, vocabulary, and helpfulness level.

questions.question: Which prompt is most likely to produce a cheerful greeting?
options: You are a grumpy old man. Say hello
You are an enthusiastic party host. Greet your guests!
questions.explanation: The enthusiastic persona directive explicitly asks for an energetic tone.

questions.question: Why is the command ‘Say “Hello, World!”’ more predictable than just ‘Hello, World!’?
options: Because the command explicitly tells the model what action to perform
questions.explanation: Direct commands remove ambiguity about the desired task.

questions.question: In prompt engineering, the process of testing and tweaking a prompt is called _____.
questions.explanation: Iterative refinement is the cycle of adjusting a prompt based on output quality.

questions.question: Which field does NOT typically benefit from prompt engineering?
questions.explanation: While AI can help with instructions, manual physical tasks aren’t directly impacted by text‑based prompts.

questions.question: True or False: A well‑crafted prompt always guarantees 100% factual accuracy.
questions.explanation: Even excellent prompts can’t eliminate hallucinations; fact‑checking remains necessary.

questions.question: What is the first habit of a great prompt engineer?
questions.explanation: Curiosity drives the exploration that uncovers what works best.

questions.question: How does providing context in a prompt affect the output?
options: It narrows the probability space towards relevant tokens
It makes the model ignore the prompt
questions.explanation: Context guides the model by increasing the odds of desired words and decreasing others.

questions.question: Which analogy best explains an LLM’s generation process?
options: A supercharged autocomplete predicting the next word
questions.explanation: LLMs continually predict the most probable next token, similar to autocomplete on steroids.

questions.question: The ability to use natural language to control AI is sometimes called ‘the hottest new programming language,’ referring to _____.
questions.explanation: Andrej Karpathy famously said that the hottest programming language is English, highlighting the power of prompting.

questions.question: True or False: Prompt engineering skills are only useful for technical developers.
questions.explanation: Professionals in marketing, writing, law, education, and many other domains leverage prompt engineering daily.

questions.question: What should you do when the model gives a poor answer?
options: Immediately assume the model is broken
Repeat the exact same prompt louder (in caps)
Analyse the output and refine the prompt with more clarity or examples
questions.explanation: Iteration – analysing what went wrong and adjusting the prompt – is the core of prompt engineering.
